name: Mission Planner
decides: The science objective, the orbit, and the launch vehicle.
wants: The objective met, on budget, on schedule.
tension: Will cut an instrument to protect budget reserve, which Science will fight.

name: Science Lead
tension: Every instrument added is mass, power and data that Engineering and Operations must absorb.

name: Spacecraft Engineer
decides: Solar array, battery, attitude control, propulsion, thermal, structure.
wants: A bus that can actually carry and power what Science asked for.
tension: Needs a bigger array and a stronger structure, and both cost money the Planner is guarding.

name: Operations
decides: Communications, mission lifetime, and when to simulate.
wants: Every bit of collected science reaching the ground, for the full mission.
tension: The one who points out that nobody can downlink any of this.
